newsitem.title: FRANCE: Danone targets stronger results growth.
newsitem.headline: Danone targets stronger results growth.

text.p: French food group Danone will strive to further improve results growth in 1997, chairman Franck Riboud said on Wednesday.

"For 1997, our goal is to confirm the positive trend of 1996 and to improve the growth pace of our results... We have the means to meet that objective," chairman Franck Riboud told an annual shareholders meeting.

"If I say that our objectives are to increase value for shareholders and net earnings per share while insuring a profitable growth of turnover and continuing to improve our operating margin, you can count on me and on the group's managers," he added.
Net attributable profit rose to 3.38 billion francs in 1996 from 2.13 billion francs in 1995. Turnover rose to 83.9 billion from 79.4 billion.
